notes.title: v1.0.2 Update (Oct 11th, 2019)
notes.content:
The following changes have been applied for the game upon the v1.0.2 patch:

New contents:
- You can now view the obtained/maximum number of donuts during chapter select for each stage.
- You can now view the obtained/maximum number of F.K. dolls during chapter select for each stage, after clearing the game.

Bug fixes:
- At the Franklin Rose Church / Graveyard stage, near the end of the stage where the player enters the dark area, fixed an issue which may render the player to be unable to proceed further upon the character's death and retry.
- Fixed several text mistakes in the messenger app.
- Fixed an error in the credits staff roll.
- Fixed various bugs which may occur as a result of having the monitor display framerate at 120Hz.
